description: Canonical folder and file contract for Figma page JSON → production Pug/Sass. Agents must follow this — not legacy monoliths.

must: set title and bodyClass in block var
block main contains include lines only — no section markup
mustNot: section.* roots in the page entry file

sass.mustNot: Tailwind utility names as custom child classes — see automation/agent-rules/01-layout-agent.md §A

manifest.source: SECTION_MANIFEST in agent-coding-prompt.txt (from json meta.moduleRegions or agent-compiler expandModuleRegions)
manifest.rule: manifest line count === module folder count === page include count
manifest.forbidden: multiple section.* roots in one index.pug

buildPipeline.sass: gulp glob src/modules/**/*.sass → main.min.css (any folder depth)
buildPipeline.referenceOutsideSrc: automation/reference/ is NOT compiled — safe for agent snippets

legacyExceptions.pattern: monolith — many section.home-* in one file
legacyExceptions.agentRule: DO NOT COPY file structure; use automation/reference/snippets/ instead
